name: lds-mods
description: Claude Code mods built on local-develop-server (lds): a publicity-aware guard for Bash remote writes, and a session pane.

plugins.name: lds-leak-guard
plugins.description: Deny Bash remote writes (git push / gh create / cargo publish ...) on a PUBLIC repository, ask otherwise, and route local git writes to mcp__lds__git_*.

plugins.name: lds-ops-pane
plugins.description: A pane and a band above the prompt showing the lds session: root, publicity, owned worktrees, latest journal chapter.
